text:
rachael (sales): Starting Nightingale POC thread. Acceptance target: 500 qps sustained for chat completions; latency target p95 <= 220ms on 256-token context. Prospect requires KMS and DPA for PHI tests. Can someone own orchestration + final summary?

diego (se): I can run orchestration and coordinate nodes. Plan: Dedicated-2 pool primary, Private deploy for PHI cases (customer KMS). We'll do model variants rwd-7b (fp16) and rwd-3b-quant. What's the workload mix?

raj (nightingale): 85% chat completions, avg response ~32 tokens; 15% embeddings batched (512 per req). A small percentage (~2%) of prompts will contain PHI for acceptance checks. Mel will own security questionnaire.

mei (perf-eng): Proposed test outline:
- Prep: preload KV cache, set continuous batching on
- Warmup: 30m @200 qps (validate p95/p99 stability)
- Ramp: linear 200->500 over 20m
- Sustain: 90m @500 qps (collect metrics)
- Spike/soak: 5x 30s bursts at 1k qps and 10m cooldown
- Failure injection: kill a worker mid-sustain to observe tail latency/backpressure
Metrics: p50/p90/p95/p99, per-token latency, batch sizes, GPU util, queue depth, retries, backend errors. Traces will be exported to s3 for posthoc analysis.

diego (se): Add a traffic-split check: route 12% to rwd-3b-quant to ensure parity. Also verify embedding path throughput separately (target 2000 vectors/s).

rachael (sales): Procurement asked for a cost ballpark for a 72h Dedicated run and an order-of-magnitude monthly ops cost for scaling to 1k qps sustained. Also need lead times for Private + KMS onboarding.

mei (perf-eng): Quick numbers (ballpark):
- 72h Dedicated-2 run (full intensity with spikes): ~$3.2k - $4.5k (GPU-hours + traffic egress)
- 1k qps sustained (monthly ops, infra + support): rough estimate ~$70k - $95k/month depending on reserved capacity discounts and embedding mix
I'll produce a detailed breakout (GPU-hours, storage, egress, reserved vs on-demand) after the run.

melissa (nightingale-sec): Sending security questionnaire now. Confirmed PHI subset -> Private deployment required with customer-managed KMS and signed DPA. Lead time: KMS key provisioning + contract ~10-14 business days. For an accelerated timeline we can start non-PHI tests on Dedicated while KMS is provisioned.

kms-bot: KMS request received (req-9001). To provision customer-managed key we need: service principal, allowed IP ranges, and DPA signed. ETA 8-12 business days after details received.

mei (perf-eng): During warmup observed rwd-7b p95 ~170ms at 240 qps, p99 ~420ms, GPU util ~72%. rwd-3b-quant p95 ~190ms but slightly higher p99 460ms. Embedding batches hit 2.1k vect/s on dedicated nodes. I'll push interim graphs to s3.

diego (se): Runbook snippet for ops team: 
```
# run id: nightingale-9001
REDWOOD_ENV=dedicated-2 REDWOOD_RUN_ID=nightingale-9001 \
./bin/runner --profile load-tests --target https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat --users 500 --ramp 20m
# enable flags: CONT_BATCHING=true KV_PREFIX_CACHE=true
```
Include fallback policy: auto-route to hosted rwd-7b-fp16 if node health drops, with a warning that p95 will increase ~30-60ms.

rachael (sales): Thanks. Can you also prepare a 1-page acceptance checklist for Nightingale procurement: key tests, expected metrics, how PHI tests will be validated, and required contract items? Procurement wants a short doc for their vendor review.

mei (perf-eng): Will do. After the sustain I'll upload results.csv with columns: ts,qps,p50,p90,p95,p99,avg_token_time,gpu_util,queue_len,errors,variant. Also PNGs for latency heatmaps and a short summary paragraph.

deploy-bot: test run started (id: nightingale-9001) 1:04 UTC. Artifacts streaming to s3://perf-nightingale/nightingale-9001/. Warmup phase active.

deploy-bot: warmup complete. Entering ramp. Current sample: rwd-7b p95 168ms, rwd-3b-quant p95 185ms, gpu_util 74%.

mei (perf-eng): Sustain complete: 500 qps for 90m achieved. Aggregate p95 = 205ms (rwd-7b), p99 = 470ms. During simulated worker kill we saw p99 spike to ~1.1s for <2m, then recovered as load rebalanced. Spike bursts to 1k qps succeeded but increased error rate on embedding path by ~0.5% during peak.

rachael (sales): Great. Raj 1: can you confirm if Nightingale needs the PHI acceptance run in the initial POC window or can that be delayed until Private/KMS is ready? If delayed, we can finalize Dedicated results sooner.

raj (nightingale): We can postpone PHI acceptance to the Private window. Proceed with Dedicated benchmarks and send the security questionnaire answers to melissa. She'll coordinate DPA and KMS.

rachael (sales): Perfect. Next steps: mei to upload full artifacts and cost breakout, diego to publish runbook + fallback doc, melissa to proceed with questionnaire and DPA/KMS onboarding. Finance will follow up with formal quotes for 1k qps monthly. Closing loop here. Thanks everyone!
